title: ShakeDown - Level 1 Golden Dome Dash - LM Arena asset run
release_target: one playable opening level today; intro + majority quad + short dome + Fox escape

references: embedded reference image 1: Cinnamon source model sheet
embedded reference image 2: Cinnamon action sheet

runtime.asset_scaling: nearest-neighbor for sprites/tiles; no smoothing at 1x; do not bake collisions into art
runtime.physics_authority: separate declarative geometry, not pixel silhouettes

zones.label: The Shake Snatch
zones.beats: Fox steals the cup at vendor; move right; one 80 px high sign obstacle; 3 safe tokens.

zones.label: Open Lawn
zones.beats: Run over gentle lawn ramps, bench jump, low hedge, generous landing; first GO wave seen on inactive bridge safely.

zones.label: Banner Crossing
zones.beats: First bridge at x1700 activates on pulse. Safe lower detour remains; upper route gives 4 bonus tokens.

zones.label: Concession Trouble
zones.beats: Walk under banners; swish or stomp Cup Crawler, dodge obvious cannon fire; ground route stays available.

zones.label: Drum Beacon Yard
zones.beats: First manual Drum Beacon at x3250 opens raised gold ledges; no hard locked gate; top route more fun, bottom route safe.

zones.label: Pep Rally Sprint
zones.beats: Parade utility cart travels 410 px on safe track; two timed gold lifts and cannon warning; optional upper token line. Fox visible in far distance.

zones.label: Golden Dome Scramble
zones.beats: Golden Dome hero background enters; 3 tier step climb using one beacon and two familiar gold lifts; one clear high vantage payoff.
zones.enemies: no new enemy classes; optional Cup Crawler x5520

zones.label: The Fox Gets Away
zones.beats: Player nears thief; final cup and Fox in foreground; taunt, poof, green drips lead offscreen; LEVEL CLEAR; no boss.

assets.title: Daylight sky
assets.role: Opaque far background; all outdoor zones
assets.visual: Clean warm pale blue campus daylight sky; gentle white clouds only in upper third; no ground, no buildings, no playable objects.
assets.variant: Opaque full-bleed non-tileable; camera scroll factor 0.08; top-left

assets.title: Campus approach silhouette
assets.visual: Side-scrolling backdrop of leafy collegiate lawn, distant generic masonry halls, low tree skyline; warm blue-gold pennants distant; ground plane visually quiet and flat at bottom; no recognizable foreground props.
assets.variant: Separate from sky, transparent lower horizon; parallax 0.22

assets.title: South Quad architecture
assets.visual: Long collegiate brick and pale-stone facades, open windows, mild buttress and arch details, generous lawn; recognizable Notre Dame ambience without measured geography; no embedded jumpable stairs/platforms.

assets.title: Quad tree and lawn midground

assets.visual: Sparse stylized mature trees and low manicured hedges receding behind playfield; soft lawn, distant path, a few blue/gold pennants; leave middle 55% visually subdued so player/enemies stand out.
assets.variant: Use transparency; place below collision/play layer; parallax 0.46

assets.title: Golden Dome hero backdrop
assets.visual: Recognizable gold-domed central campus building with broad pale stone/bricky facade and symmetric windows; dome centered in upper right half, golden statue suggestion as simple decorative shape, warm sunlight. No game platforms baked into paint.
assets.variant: Strong focal silhouette, avoid tiny unreadable gothic details; parallax 0.18

assets.title: Escape horizon
assets.visual: Campus walkway falling toward a distant tree-lined South Bend horizon, distant bridge hint; green milkshake trail belongs on gameplay layer, NOT in this backdrop.
assets.variant: Transparent upper-mid layer for finale transition; parallax 0.25

audio.title: Level loop
audio.brief: Light brisk 130-145 BPM original collegiate-style march groove: kick/snare, pizzicato bass, playful brass-like synth motif; no copyrighted school melody or chants. Output OGG or WAV plus provenance; fallback procedural sequencer; loop seam tested.

audio.title: Fox theft cue
audio.brief: Comic ascending muted brass + sliding plucked bass, brisk and cheeky.

audio.title: Jump
audio.brief: Short springy pitched ascending pop, under 0.15 s.

audio.title: Double jump
audio.brief: Second ascending chime over springy transient; distinguish from single jump.

audio.title: Tail swish
audio.brief: Compact brush whoosh with a short low pop, avoid sharp loud noise.

audio.title: Pickup
audio.brief: Tiny two-tone sparkle, bright but not shrill.

audio.title: Checkpoint
audio.brief: Gentle resolved major triad arcade chime.

audio.title: GO pulse
audio.brief: Two percussive drum hits and short cheerful brass swell; a visual substitute exists.

audio.title: IRISH reset
audio.brief: Downward paired drum rim taps, softer than GO.

audio.title: Cannon tell
audio.brief: Two warning clicks with small rattling paper shuffle.

audio.title: Cannon fire
audio.brief: Soft party pop and fluttering paper whoosh; restrained loudness.

audio.title: Damage
audio.brief: Soft but clear dissonant bump; never piercing.

audio.title: Fox escapes
audio.brief: Comic descending trombone-like slide or pluck, no speech required.

audio.title: Level clear
audio.brief: Original triumphant brass/chiptune cadence with playful final wrong-note chuckle.
